dataset_provenance.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / AWS Open Data Copernicus DEM
dataset_provenance.licence: Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms / Open Access Public Dataset

algorithms.hydrology_algorithm: D8 steepest descent flow routing with Priority-Flood pit conditioning (Barnes et al., 2014)

scientific_notes: Elevation derived from genuine Copernicus GLO-30 DSM raster. Slope computed using central finite differences on metric grid. Local relief represents elevation difference within 100m radius. Flow accumulation calculated using D8 flow routing across a subcatchment window after Priority-Flood depression conditioning. This exploratory terrain index is non-probabilistic.
